name: MARC I Hub Line

values.Owner: Central New York Oil and Gas Co

researcher_notes: A Federal Register notice from June 2011 (FERC docket CP10-480) describes about 39 miles of 30-inch pipeline in Bradford, Sullivan and Lycoming Counties, Pennsylvania, by Central New York Oil and Gas Company. A Natural Gas Intelligence news item says FERC approved partial service on or before November 14 (2012) and that the company would seek approval for full service by December 1. Search results from the same outlet and others give about 550,000 Dth/d of firm capacity and a cost near 200 million dollars; those figures were not read on a verified page, so they are not staged. Full in-service confirmation was not found, so operating is inferred from the partial-service approval. No existing row matches: roster checked for Bradford, Lycoming, MARC and CNYOG. NYMarc (P0233) is a different New York project. Length of 39 miles exceeds the 25 km rule. No route was found. Owner spelling follows the ownership team style hit for Central New York Oil and Gas Co. Later parent is Crestwood, not staged.
